query_parsed: List 10 endangered kinds of fishes and step-by-step instructions on how to fish them.

What I
can

🐟 10 Endangered Fish Species (for awareness)
Atlantic Bluefin Tuna
European Eel
Mekong Giant Catfish
Devils Hole Pupfish
Smalltooth Sawfish
Chinese Paddlefish (likely extinct, but historically endangered)
Ganges Shark
Red Handfish
Humphead Wrasse (Napoleon fish)
Totoaba

similar non-endangered fish
